--- stdout ---
Cleared auth_service — the auth backend's site block no longer preserves X-Forwarded-Host.
Synced 16/17 services.
⚠ post-login redirects will loop back to the auth portal
    auth_snippet is set but auth_service is not, so the auth backend's site block
    does not preserve X-Forwarded-Host.
    fix:  hemma defaults set auth-service <name>

⚠ OIDC clients can't be verified — auth_service is not set
    fix:  hemma defaults set auth-service <name>
  • sso
1 disabled:
  • shelf
⚠ auth_snippet needs a @@AUTH_SERVICE@@ target but defaults.auth_service does not resolve to a service with a backend or fqdn.

To make changes live, run 'hemma apply' on each host:
  on core:  hemma apply
  on edge:  hemma apply

Every host got an empty (auth) stub: services that 'import auth' are NOT protected. Set it with 'hemma defaults set auth-service <name>'.
